title: Stage-3 per-attempt edit score
description: The versioned score of ONE edit run record (one task x arm x repetition cell), emitted by edit_scorer.score_run. Three gates are derived from the record's raw gate outcomes: behavior (oracle existing_suite AND discrimination), convention (conformance) and blast (oracle changed_path AND api_impact). all_gates_passed -- the headline predicate -- is the CONJUNCTION of the three; a patch that only satisfies behaviour is not fully correct. FAILS CLOSED: an absent or unjudged gate scores passed=false with reason GATE_ABSENT and can never contribute to the headline.

seed.description: The repetition identity of the cell.

cell.description: The planned-cell coordinate this score fills.

status.description: The S3.4 runner's terminal status for the cell.

reason.description: The S3.4 runner's terminal sub-reason code.

all_gates_passed.description: HEADLINE predicate: behavior AND convention AND blast.

matrix_cell.description: This attempt's cell in the eight-cell pass matrix, ordered behavior, convention, blast.

failure_class.description: null exactly when all_gates_passed is true; otherwise the single bucket this failure belongs to.

judged.description: False when no gate outcome was recorded for this cell; such a gate is scored passed=false (fail closed).

reasons.description: Sorted reason codes from the underlying sub-gates; GATE_ABSENT when unjudged.

failure_class.description: agent_failure: the agent never produced a judgeable attempt (provider error, timeout, tool-isolation violation). invalid_patch: a patch existed but was empty or unappliable. harness_failure: our tooling/environment broke (config error, missing command, tool failure, malformed rule) -- NOT evidence about the agent. oracle_failure: the gate ran but the oracle material itself is defective (non-discriminating or wrong-direction test, decoy/stale/absent anchor, ambiguous match). patch_rejected: the gates judged the patch and it was genuinely wrong. missing_cell: the cell was planned but never observed. These are never collapsed: only patch_rejected is evidence the agent was wrong.
